### Added
- Two components, off by default: `components.model-manager` ([model-manager](https://github.com/giantswarm/model-manager), model inventory / pull / load / unload / delete and kagent `ModelConfig` wiring on an Ollama or KServe backend) and `components.agent-manager` ([agent-manager](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-manager), the agent write surface: kagent agents as Flux `HelmRelease`s of the agent chart), each as REST and MCP through muster's own `MCPServer` CR and each acting as the user (OAuth 2.1 resource server, forwarded id_tokens, downstream OAuth to the Kubernetes API, no ServiceAccount RBAC). The `model-manager:` / `agent-manager:` blocks are forwarded to the component releases; the `modelManager:` / `agentManager:` blocks drive the wiring the connectivity chart renders for them — the agentgateway route and JWT policy (`route.*`, the kagent controller route's shape), the network policies in both flavors (ingress from the data plane, muster and the kubelet's probes; egress to DNS, the Kubernetes API, the identity provider, the Ollama endpoint or the Hugging Face Hub, the agent chart's registry and GitHub) and render-time guards (backend, endpoint, KServe and Flux APIs, kagent on and same namespace, muster for the MCPServer CR, the OAuth inputs, route mode / hostname / parentRef / JWKS egress). `make verify-managers` covers them; `examples/customer-bom.yaml` pins both. **No installation needs to act**: both components are off and the default render is unchanged.
- `agent-platform.dnsEgressWithProxy`, `agent-platform.urlHost` and `agent-platform.idpEgress.cilium` helpers in the connectivity chart: a DNS egress rule with Cilium's proxy clause for policies that select destinations by name, and the egress a platform service needs to reach the login identity provider (by name on 443, plus the cluster entity on 443/10443 for an issuer behind an in-cluster Gateway).
